openapi: 3.0.0
info:
  title: Simple User API
  description: A basic API to manage and retrieve user information.
  version: 1.0.0
servers:
  - url: https://example.com
    description: Production server
paths:
  /users:
    get:
      summary: Get a list of users
      description: Returns a list of all registered users in the system.
      responses:
        '200':
          description: A successful response returning a list of users.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/User'
components:
  schemas:
    User:
      type: object
      required:
        - id
        - name
      properties:
        id:
          type: integer
          format: int64
          example: 1
        name:
          type: string
          example: "Jane Doe"
        email:
          type: string
          format: email
          example: "jane.doe@example.com"
